published_ranges._ams: 1 kg spools sold as AMS compatible
published_ranges._notes: Nozzle 240-265C appears on ~127 PETG PRO pages. Density 1.27 g/ml (26C) and Tg 78C are from the 'Atomic - PETG/PCTG based 3D Filaments' SDS (rev 07/16/2026), which covers both PETG and PCTG; no PETG TDS published. Drying 65C 8-16h from the Atomic FAQ ('time is dependent on dryer'). Several PETG colours are marked as being discontinued and replaced by PCTG PRO. Also sold in 3.5 kg and 2.85 mm (Crystal Clear / Natural).

conflicts: Bed temperature varies by colour page: 80C +/-10 on most pages (used); 60-70C on ~22 pages (e.g. https://atomicfilament.com/products/true-gold-petg-pro); 70C +/-10 on ~10 (e.g. https://atomicfilament.com/products/cashmere-petg-pro-ams-compatible); 70-90C on ~15 (e.g. https://atomicfilament.com/products/crystal-clear-natural-petg-pro-2-85mm-1kg); 60-75C (nozzle 240-265C) on Starry Night (https://atomicfilament.com/products/starry-night-translucent-petg-pro).
Indigo Golden Sparkle Translucent page gives nozzle 232-245C (https://atomicfilament.com/products/indigo-golden-sparkle-trans-petg).
Translucent Neon Hot Pink UV Reactive and Gray sample pages give nozzle 240-245C (https://atomicfilament.com/products/trans-neon-hot-pink-petg-uv-react).
Metallic Silver v2 page gives nozzle 240-255C (https://atomicfilament.com/products/metallic-silver-v2-petg-pro-1).
